definition: A seed, rule, tool, or record is supplied from outside the target package.
The analyst chooses or executes the enabling operation.
certificate: operator identity, timestamp, and intervention record
boundary: May reveal a carrier possibility but does not make the birth carrier-generated.

definition: Native substrate dynamics produces the enabling event.
boundary: Need not be self-maintained or self-audited.

definition: Another theory/package supplies a bridged record or operation that is load-bearing.
certificate: peer bridge, independence, fidelity, and price
boundary: Enablement is not descent from the peer.

definition: An observer/instrument creates the decisive exposure or admission opportunity.
boundary: Observer contribution must not be credited to the uninstrumented carrier.

definition: The package carries, reaches, executes, repairs, and audits its own generator under closed-loop budgets.
boundary: A one-off internally located event is insufficient.

certificate: contribution decomposition and counterfactual withdrawal tests
boundary: No single source receives exclusive credit.
